facts.deployment: Authors report the heuristic deployed internally.

sources.scope: Gemini/Pallas/TPU ecosystem; authored by the developers, not an independent Astra/Terra trial. Supports plausibility of useful algorithm discovery, not our throughput, costs, demand or probability of success.

sources.title: Towards Robust Agentic CUDA Kernel Benchmarking, Verification, and Optimization

facts.reportedLoop: Ten generations; candidate generation, verification, compilation, correctness and timing.
facts.performanceQualification: Selected forward tasks improved over PyTorch eager; unseen-shape performance varied, including overfitting.
facts.evaluationRisk: The paper addresses exploitable benchmarking loopholes and varied-condition correctness.

sources.scope: The retrieved primary paper does not call its benchmark KernelEval. Its costs/timings are paper-specific and exclude our product integration, support and failed-venture history; its eager baseline is not a guarantee of beating tuned libraries.

sources.title: OptiMUS-0.3: Using large language models to model and solve optimization problems at scale

facts.deliverableType: Executable mixed-integer/linear programming models, solver code, debugging and solution checks.
facts.caseStudyData: Synthetic data matched to published operational case scales.

sources.scope: Evidence for modeling and solver assembly on benchmark problems. Case-study resemblance does not establish customer purchase or correct interpretation of an unseen operational policy.

sources.title: Automated Optimization Modeling through Expert-Guided Large Language Model Reasoning

facts.criticism: Evaluating only an optimum value can miss errors in the modeled constraints and problem meaning.

sources.scope: A task-specific warning against accepting executable solver output as proof that the intended business problem was represented correctly. The reported error maximum is not a universal error rate.

sources.title: PDEBench: An Extensive Benchmark for Scientific Machine Learning

facts.benchmark: Time-dependent PDE tasks with code/data, classical simulation and learned baselines, varying initial/boundary conditions and physical parameters.

sources.scope: A public validation substrate for numerical surrogate/solver products. Not a frontier-agent benchmark, physical-system certification or evidence of fee-paying demand.

sources.title: Measuring the Impact of Early-2025 AI on Experienced Open-Source Developer Productivity

facts.models: Predominantly Cursor with Claude 3.5/3.7 Sonnet; early-2025 tasks in mature familiar repositories.

sources.scope: Counterevidence against an automatic professional-software productivity multiplier. It does not estimate current Astra/Terra autonomous kernel or solver performance.

sources.title: We are Changing our Developer Productivity Experiment Design

facts.interpretation: Authors judge newer estimates unreliable because of developer/task selection and concurrent-agent time-measurement problems; possible later speedups remain poorly identified.

sources.scope: Keep the earlier adverse finding and the later limitation together. Neither supports a universal current slowdown or a precise positive frontier multiplier.
